Messages.Author: Andrew Edward Joubert
Messages.Body:
Okay, here are yet more questions about my favorite
addiction:

Who can recieve blood from a hunting ground?  Is it
just a vampire of the clan the hunting ground is for,
or once it's down can any vampire use it?

How do bloodhunt votes work?  The rules say that "any Methuselah may
immediately call a vote amoung all the Methuselahs..." 
So a blood hunt vote is simply a vote amoung all the PLAYERS
(in other words is probably always a failure in a two player game)

How is equipment transfered?  Does it tap one or both vampires?
Is it at +1 stealth?

Does a full uncontrolled vampire have to come into play?
Useful for those vampires about to be contested.

thank ya'll right kindly,
       --Andrew

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Andrew Edward Joubert <aejouber@mailhost.ecn.uoknor.edu> wrote:
>Who can recieve blood from a hunting ground?  Is it
>just a vampire of the clan the hunting ground is for,
>or once it's down can any vampire use it?

Once it's down, any of your ready vampires may use it.

>How do bloodhunt votes work?  The rules say that "any Methuselah may
>immediately call a vote amoung all the Methuselahs..." 
>So a blood hunt vote is simply a vote amoung all the PLAYERS
>(in other words is probably always a failure in a two player game)

Well, I wouldn't quite say it's "among all the players", since titled
vampires will be able to contribute their votes.  The only restriction
on a bloodhunt vote is that action modifiers and reactions may not be used.

>How is equipment transfered?  Does it tap one or both vampires?
>Is it at +1 stealth?

One minion taps as an equip action to get the equipment from your other
minion; this does not tap the donating minion.  All equip actions are
taken at +1 stealth.

>Does a full uncontrolled vampire have to come into play?

At the end of your influence phase, yes.

Messages.Author: Tor Iver Wilhelmsen
Messages.Body:
aejouber@mailhost.ecn.uoknor.edu (Andrew Edward Joubert) writes:
>Okay, here are yet more questions about my favorite
>addiction:
>
>Who can recieve blood from a hunting ground?  Is it
>just a vampire of the clan the hunting ground is for,
>or once it's down can any vampire use it?

Any vampire, but you need a vamp of the appropriate clan to get it into
play.

>How do bloodhunt votes work?  The rules say that "any Methuselah may
>immediately call a vote amoung all the Methuselahs..." 
>So a blood hunt vote is simply a vote amoung all the PLAYERS
>(in other words is probably always a failure in a two player game)

Vamps with positions give votes, but since the vote is not from an action
you cannot play reaction or action modifier cards (naturally).

>How is equipment transfered?  Does it tap one or both vampires?
>Is it at +1 stealth?

You only tap the acting vampire, and yes, it's at +1 stealth.

>Does a full uncontrolled vampire have to come into play?
>Useful for those vampires about to be contested.

Yes, they automatically come out at the end of influence if their capacity
is full.
